adaptations: Replace runner imports with neutral bundled computation types and projector; exclude transport, registration, journals, and CLI.
Relocate the original factory to factory.py and add lazy imports so optional SciPy is required only when callbacks are created.
Retain only the two callback fields in Components; supplied-plane mode has no optional estimator.
Serialize the unchanged configuration object as a separately hashed configuration.json; retain original scoped settings and aggregate evidence bytes.
Apply repository formatting without changing computation, thresholds, precision, segment order, or fallback behavior.
Use explicit DepthAI image/calibration/plane conversion and frame-local owned parcel messages outside the bundled computation directory.

Use native DepthAI HostNode synchronization for complete groups instead of adapter queues and timeouts. Scope status enums under public message owners and keep diagnostic/timing record classes internal. Frozen computation and scene conversion are unchanged.

Read delivered image intrinsics, distortion, and camera-to-reference poses from native ImgTransformation metadata instead of custom calibration objects. Invert calibrated camera poses in float64 millimeters for XYZ already in the common reference frame; retain the explicit plane/gravity input. Replace parcel attribute-assignment bypasses with normal constructors and read-only properties.

Reuse the existing SupportPlane in build and ParcelDetectorConfig instead of a stamped ParcelPlane or explicit gravity. Orient the plane toward the reference camera, which must be above the surface. Use a ThreadedHostNode with native host Sync for four DEVICE-timestamp scene streams and a separate bounded blocking config queue read once with tryGet before each scene. Apply an available update to stored state; otherwise keep the current configuration. process receives only scene messages. Validate scene message datatypes once in process. Keep pointCloud and supportPlane names consistent. Accept RAW8 as well as GRAY8 mono frames, including native rectified outputs with matching virtual calibration. Frozen computation is unchanged.

Add a one-time resolution check at the process boundary for the evaluated unrectified image profile: color 2000x1500, left/right 1280x800. Log expected and received sizes on mismatch and continue processing, following the user override of the updated handoff rejection policy. No resize, geometry conversion, pixel-threshold scaling, or frozen computation changes. The initial SupportPlane is optional; inactive scene groups are consumed without processing or output until a config supplies the plane.
Relocate the identical computation and frozen settings to the stable implementation/ directory. Preserve full evaluated candidate identity independently of package location.
Package and hash visualization.html, retaining its own documentation-source revision and recording link-only repairs.

Snapshot parcel message points into immutable bytes-backed float32 storage to prevent mutation through retained aliases or the public array. The detector incurs one boundary snapshot; measurement does not copy points.
Decode UTF-8 package text independently of the host locale. Restore documentation chart keyboard focus without changing computation or evaluation data.

inputs.frame_convention: Millimeter XYZ in the common calibration reference frame identified by native target device/socket metadata. SupportPlane supplied in build or ParcelDetectorConfig uses those same coordinates. The reference camera must be above the surface; either normal sign is accepted. Native PointCloud uses DEFAULT coordinates, calibrated translation, and an identity custom transform. Other producers must normalize XYZ and metadata to this frame. The capture interval and device clock must be shared. Use delivered-grid calibration and the evaluated unrectified source-image profile; other grids can change eligibility despite correct calibration.

image_profile.resolution_check: Once per detector instance after valid scene message types; warn with all expected and received sizes on mismatch, then continue processing. User override of updated handoff rejection policy.
image_profile.geometry_policy: Preserve native field of view, orientation, and unrectified geometry. Dimensions alone do not verify these properties. No automatic resize, crop, rectification, or threshold scaling. Other profiles have no equivalence guarantee.

preferred_neural_depth.validation: Upstream recommendation only; ParcelDetector receives PointCloudData, not a depth image.

inputs.support_plane_configuration: Optional SupportPlane in build, default None. While unset, consume and discard synchronized groups without scene decoding, algorithm execution or outputs. ParcelDetectorConfig supplies the plane and activates subsequent groups without restarting. Config messages still require a real SupportPlane.

Native Sync, SupportPlane, and runtime configuration revision
checks.result: 49 native checks pass. Four scene inputs synchronize by DEVICE timestamp below 10 ms without requiring equal sequence counters. run blocks on the scene group and reads config once with tryGet; an available update changes stored state before process. Pending configs apply in FIFO order, one per scene. State persists without further updates. Invalid config datatypes log a warning and are ignored. In-flight updates apply to a later scene, while existing batch planes remain unchanged. SupportPlane is optional in build. Without one, scene groups are consumed without decoding, detection or outputs; a later config activates subsequent scenes without a restart. ParcelDetectorConfig has only supportPlane. Native host Rectification metadata conversion passes; rectified images remain outside the evaluated unrectified profile.
